title: Jiangxi Hungpai New Materials Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Materials Manufacturer
content:
Jiangxi Hungpai New Materials Co., Ltd. is a Chinese silicon-based materials producer whose official website includes aerogel as a featured product-center category. The company is broadly active in silane coupling agents, fumed silica, and other silicone-related material systems, with aerogel publicly presented as part of its product portfolio.

Company Overview

Hungpai is a large industrial materials company with a strong silica and silane background. Its official website clearly identifies aerogel as one of the company’s product-center categories, making it a relevant addition to the China aerogel materials directory.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: China with large-scale industrial manufacturing reach.
  • Focus Areas: Silicon-based advanced materials, silica-related products, and aerogel materials within a broader specialty-materials portfolio.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Aerogel product category listed on the official site
  • Fumed silica and silane-based specialty materials
  • Public Capacity: A dedicated aerogel output figure is not clearly disclosed on the reviewed official pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Production Base: Jiangxi, China.
  • International Certifications: The reviewed official pages do not clearly list aerogel-specific international certification details.
  • Official Website: https://www.hungpaisilane.com/

FAQ

Why is Jiangxi Hungpai listed in an aerogel directory?

The company’s official product center includes aerogel as a named product category, which indicates a public commercial aerogel offering rather than a purely indirect reference.

What other material lines does Hungpai operate?

Its official website highlights silane coupling agents, fumed silica, silicone-related materials, and aerogel within a broader advanced-materials portfolio.

Is an aerogel production figure public?

A dedicated aerogel output figure is not clearly disclosed on the reviewed official pages.
